---
title: Home
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          # Inside the fixed header, with the configured type and icon.
          # Descendant selectors only: the preview wraps each chrome slot
          # in a `display: contents` div. Placement relative to the
          # navbar is pinned by the template unit tests.
          - 'header#quarto-header #quarto-announcement.alert.alert-warning'
          - '#quarto-announcement[data-announcement-remember="false"]'
          - '#quarto-announcement i.bi.bi-info-circle.quarto-announcement-icon'
          # Content is markdown (link resolution: see project-render.qmd).
          - '#quarto-announcement .quarto-announcement-content strong'
          - '#quarto-announcement .quarto-announcement-content a'
          # The close control is a labelled button (q2 change from Q1's <i>).
          - '#quarto-announcement button.quarto-announcement-action[type="button"][aria-label="Close announcement"]'
        - []
---

A page that shows the site announcement.
